items.informal_name: Divisibility of Primitive Polynomials via Fraction Ring Extension
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
  [IsDomain R] [Nonempty (NormalizedGCDMonoid R)] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.IsPrimitive → q.IsPrimitive → Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p ∣ Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) q → p ∣ q
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative ring and $ K $ its fraction field. If $ p $ and $ q $ are primitive polynomials in $ R[X] $, and the image of $ p $ under the canonical ring homomorphism $ R \to K $ divides the image of $ q $ in $ K[X] $, then $ p $ divides $ q $ in $ R[X] $.

items.informal_name: Divisibility by Normalized Coprime Polynomial Factor
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] (p : Polynomial K) {q : Polynomial K},
  q ≠ 0 → Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (p / gcd p q) ∣ p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ and non-zero polynomial $ q $ over a field $ K $, the product of the constant polynomial with coefficient equal to the inverse of the leading coefficient of $ q / \gcd(p, q) $ and the polynomial $ p / \gcd(p, q) $ divides $ p $. This constructs a normalized coprime divisor of $ p $ by adjusting the leading coefficient of the coprime part of $ q $.

items.informal_name: Divisibility of Primitive Polynomials in Fraction Rings
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
  [IsDomain R] [Nonempty (NormalizedGCDMonoid R)] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.IsPrimitive → q.IsPrimitive → (p ∣ q ↔ Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p ∣ Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) q)
items.informal_description: For primitive polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ over a commutative ring $ R $, $ p $ divides $ q $ in $ R[X] $ if and only if their images under the canonical map to the fraction ring $ K $ satisfy $ p_{K} \mid q_{K} $ in $ K[X] $.

items.informal_name: Normalized Denominator of Rational Function $ p/q $
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] (p : Polynomial K) {q : Polynomial K},
  q ≠ 0 →
    ((algebraMap (Polynomial K) (RatFunc K)) p / (algebraMap (Polynomial K) (RatFunc K)) q).denom =
      Polynomial.C (q / gcd p q).leadingCoeff⁻¹ * (q / gcd p q)
items.informal_description: For polynomials $ p $ and nonzero $ q $ over a commutative domain $ K $, the normalized denominator of the rational function $ \frac{p}{q} $ is given by $ \text{Polynomial.C}(\text{leadingCoeff}(q/\gcd(p,q))^{-1}) \cdot (q/\gcd(p,q)) $, where $ \gcd(p,q) $ denotes the greatest common divisor of $ p $ and $ q $. This expression ensures the denominator is monic and coprime with the numerator.

items.informal_description:
A tactic function that computes the greatest common divisor of two quantifier normal forms $l_1$ and $l_2$ in the context of field simplification. Given a group with zero structure $M$, a discharger function for proofs, and a denominator condition $C$, it returns a tuple containing: 
1. A common factor $L$ in quantifier normal form
2. Simplified forms $l_1'$ and $l_2'$
3. Proof that $\text{NF.eval}(L.toNF) \cdot \text{NF.eval}(l_1'.toNF) = \text{NF.eval}(l_1.toNF)$
4. Proof that $\text{NF.eval}(L.toNF) \cdot \text{NF.eval}(l_2'.toNF) = \text{NF.eval}(l_2.toNF)$
5. Proof that the evaluated normal form of $L$ satisfies the denominator condition $C$. 
This ensures valid denominator constraints during field tactic simplifications while maintaining equality relations between original and simplified forms.
